mapper.select: SELECT om.order_id AS orderId, om.camp_id AS campId, om.poi_id AS poiId, om.room_category_id AS roomCategoryId, om.room_id AS roomId, om.status AS status, om.order_type AS orderType, COALESCE(p.poi_name, om.poi_name_snapshot) AS poiName, COALESCE(rc.name, om.room_category_name_snapshot) AS roomCategoryName, COALESCE(r.room_name, om.room_name_snapshot) AS roomName, om.guest_name AS guestName, om.guest_mobile AS guestMobile, om.total_price_cent AS totalPriceCent, om.total_pay_price_cent AS totalPayPriceCent, om.commission_price_cent AS commissionPriceCent, om.payment_status AS paymentStatus, om.start_at AS startAt, om.end_at AS endAt, om.room_snapshot_json AS roomSnapshotJson, om.remark AS remark, om.guest_registered_at AS guestRegisteredAt, om.checked_out_at AS checkedOutAt FROM order_main om LEFT JOIN pms_poi p ON p.poi_id = om.poi_id AND p.camp_id = om.camp_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = om.camp_id AND rc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = om.room_id AND r.camp_id = om.camp_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE om.camp_id = #{campId} AND om.order_id = #{orderId} AND om.is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(r.room_id AS CHAR) AS roomId, r.room_name AS roomName, CAST(rc.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, CAST(p.poi_id AS CHAR) AS poiId, p.poi_name AS poiName FROM room r JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = r.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = r.camp_id AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN pms_poi p ON p.poi_id = r.poi_id AND p.camp_id = r.camp_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.camp_id = #{campId} AND r.poi_id = #{poiId} AND r.room_category_id = #{roomCategoryId} AND r.room_id != #{currentRoomId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND (r.lock_status IS NULL OR r.lock_status != 'offline') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_main occupied WHERE occupied.camp_id = r.camp_id AND occupied.room_id = r.room_id AND occupied.status IN ('booked', 'checked_in') AND occupied.is_deleted = 0 AND occupied.order_id != #{excludeOrderId} AND occupied.start_at < #{endAt} AND occupied.end_at > #{startAt} ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_status_block rsb WHERE rsb.camp_id = r.camp_id AND rsb.room_id = r.room_id AND rsb.status = 'closed' AND rsb.is_deleted = 0 AND rsb.biz_date >= #{blockStartDate} AND rsb.biz_date <= #{blockEndDate} ) ORDER BY rc.sort_no ASC, rc.room_category_id ASC, r.sort_no ASC, r.room_id ASC

SELECT CAST(r.room_id AS CHAR) AS roomId, r.room_name AS roomName, CAST(rc.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, CAST(p.poi_id AS CHAR) AS poiId, p.poi_name AS poiName FROM room r JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = r.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = r.camp_id AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN pms_poi p ON p.poi_id = r.poi_id AND p.camp_id = r.camp_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.camp_id = #{campId} AND r.poi_id = #{poiId} AND r.room_category_id = #{roomCategoryId} AND r.room_id = #{roomId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND (r.lock_status IS NULL OR r.lock_status != 'offline') LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE order_main SET status = #{status}, payment_status = COALESCE(#{paymentStatus}, payment_status), remark = COALESCE(#{remark}, remark), guest_registered_at = COALESCE(#{guestRegisteredAt}, guest_registered_at), checked_out_at = COALESCE(#{checkedOutAt}, checked_out_at), updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{userId}, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND order_id = #{orderId} AND is_deleted = 0

mapper.update: UPDATE order_main SET room_id = #{roomId}, room_name_snapshot = #{roomNameSnapshot}, room_snapshot_json = CAST(#{roomSnapshotJson} AS JSON), remark = #{remark}, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{userId}, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND order_id = #{orderId} AND is_deleted = 0
